unary_response_complete: send a unary gRPC response and complete the server-side RPC call
stream_response: send a streaming response message to the gRPC client during an active RPC
stream_response_complete: complete a server-streaming gRPC RPC after sending all response messages
send_initial_metadata: send initial metadata to the gRPC client before sending response data
application_cancel: cancel an active gRPC RPC from the server-side application with a CANCELLED status
